high_severity_items.summary: India's September headline CPI accelerated to 5.54% from 4.82% in August, a 22-month high and above consensus, driven by food inflation at 7.74% and transport costs; the RBI has already hiked rates and signalled further tightening is possible while growth forecasts were nudged up to 7.1%. Elevated oil prices tied to Middle East tensions and drought/Super El Nino risk to the rural economy add upside inflation risk and weigh on household demand.
high_severity_items.title: India’s retail inflation jumps to 5.54% in September, above estimates

high_severity_items.summary: Renewed attacks on Saudi Arabia and tankers near the Strait of Hormuz pushed WTI up 2.1% to $93.78 and Brent up 2.0% to $106.80, reviving Middle East supply-risk pricing even as OPEC pointed to a demand rebound and Russian diesel supply and a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire offered some offset. high_severity_items.summary: European natural gas benchmark TTF is approaching multi-year highs near 83 EUR/MWh amid winter supply tightness: no Qatari LNG exports, storage well below 15-year lows, and only a fragile Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire' plus improved Strait of Hormuz flows. The move points to renewed European energy supply stress and upstream cost pressure rather than broad demand-driven growth.
high_severity_items.title: European Natural Gas Prices Headed for Multi-Year Highs

high_severity_items.summary: LNG flows from the Persian Gulf remain more than 75% below pre-February 28 levels while winter heating demand builds, pushing European gas benchmarks above 81 EUR/MWh and Asian spot LNG above European levels. Coal, roughly 80% cheaper than LNG, is seeing rising demand as buyers substitute away from scarce gas, pointing to an energy supply shock with pass-through inflationary pressure.
high_severity_items.title: Global Coal Demand Rises as LNG Shortage Deepens
